item.title: fukuokaxr.org — a home for Fukuoka's XR community
item.description: IoTone Japan stood up fukuokaxr.org, a bilingual (JA/EN) landing page for Fukuoka’s XR / AR / VR community — the standing home behind events like XR VisionDevCamp Fukuoka.
